bobbin.name: Bobbin
bobbin.tagline: A textile-industry bobbin, injection-moulded from a 40% LIMEX PE78-02M + 60% PP blend.
bobbin.description: A bobbin for the textile industry, produced by injection moulding from a blend of 40% LIMEX PE78-02M and 60% PP homo-polymer (per White Dot's India case-study record). PE78-02M is a LIMEX compound that is itself ~78% calcium carbonate, so the finished bobbin carries roughly 31% limestone by mass — replacing petroleum plastic while holding the precise tolerances a high-speed spinning bobbin demands.

co2.basis: Greenhouse-gas (CO2e) reduction vs conventional plastic, application-dependent, per TBM Life-Cycle Assessment (raw material to disposal). Reference value, not guaranteed. PE78-02M compound GHG: 0.542 kg-CO2e/kg.

container.name: Paint Container
container.tagline: A paint container made from a 25% LIMEX PE78-02M + 75% PP blend, modeled from the supplied front and top reference photos.
container.description: A paint container reconstructed from the supplied front and top references. The model captures the tapered glossy red body, bright white snap lid, double rim, concentric lid rings, polished wire handle and molded-plastic finish. The formulation is 25% LIMEX PE78-02M and 75% PP homo-polymer.

co2.basis: CO2e reduction depends on confirmed part weight and lifecycle boundary. PE78-02M compound GHG reference: 0.542 kg-CO2e/kg.

motorCover.name: Motor Cover
motorCover.tagline: A glossy black injection-moulded motor fan cover, produced from a 50% LIMEX PE78-02M + 50% PP blend.
motorCover.description: A motor fan cover produced by injection moulding from an equal-blend formulation of 50% LIMEX PE78-02M and 50% PP homo-polymer. The 3D model is built from supplied reference photos capturing the glossy black cylindrical body, deep outer lip, concentric rounded ventilation slots, central mounting hole, and rear mounting collar with screw holes. At 50% LIMEX, roughly 39% of the finished part mass is limestone — displacing an equal share of petroleum-derived plastic.

co2.basis: Greenhouse-gas (CO2e) reduction vs conventional plastic, application-dependent, per TBM Life-Cycle Assessment (raw material to disposal). Reference value, not guaranteed. PE78-02M compound GHG: 0.542 kg-CO2e/kg.

aralditeContainer.name: Araldite Container
aralditeContainer.tagline: An Araldite adhesive dispenser container, injection-moulded from a 30% LIMEX + 70% PP blend, modeled from the supplied reference photos.
aralditeContainer.description: An Araldite adhesive dispenser container, injection-moulded from a 30% LIMEX + 70% PP homo-polymer blend. The 3D model is matched to the supplied reference photos: knurled white screw cap, smooth body, fluted lower grip section and blue flip-top dispensing base. Approximately 23% of the finished part mass is limestone, replacing petroleum-derived plastic.

co2.basis: CO2e reduction reference based on LIMEX compound GHG data. Exact value depends on confirmed part weight and lifecycle boundary.

handWashBottle.name: Hand Wash Bottle
handWashBottle.tagline: A faceted hand wash dispenser bottle in two colorways, modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos. Verified LIMEX composition data is in progress.
handWashBottle.description: A hand wash dispenser bottle with a distinctive elongated diamond mould pattern and a black pump head, produced in white and green colorways. The interactive 3D model shows both variants side by side and is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography, including the quilted facet geometry, matte pump finish and colors. Verified LIMEX composition and supplier spec data for this product are in progress - no figures are published until confirmed.

hardDish.name: Hard Dish
hardDish.tagline: A rigid 3-compartment serving dish in four colorways, modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos. Verified LIMEX composition data is in progress.

The interactive 3D model shows all four variants side by side and is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography, including the tapered pockets, underside support pads and feet. consilePipe.name: Concealed Pipe
consilePipe.tagline: A rigid concealed conduit pipe, modeled in 3D from the supplied reference photos. Verified LIMEX composition data is in progress.

The interactive 3D model is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography, including the flat sawn cut ends that expose the pipe's wall thickness and hollow bore. soapStand.name: Soap Stand
soapStand.application: Covered Soap Dish with Drain Insert
soapStand.tagline: A three-part covered soap dish sample marked '15% Limex', modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos.
soapStand.description: A covered soap dish in three moulded parts: a cream pillow-domed lid with an all-over knitted rice-grain emboss and a sculpted bow, a matching cream base tray with a scalloped rim, and a sage-green drain insert with 13 drainage slots that lets the soap dry between uses. The sample lid interior is handwritten '15% Limex', indicating a 15% LIMEX blend for this trial part. The interactive 3D model is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography and animates the three-part assembly. Full supplier composition and spec data are in progress - no further figures are published until confirmed.
